batch: Transport Dispatch Miniature World landmarks v2
generation: Built-in OpenAI ImageGen with transparent background, one generation per location
references: Plants blueprint v6.0 ART-AND-ANIMATION.md and APPLIED-GAMES.md from local Plants 092ff78
Transport docs/DISPATCH-ART-PRODUCTION-BRIEF.md and the current roadside-plot layout
intendedUse: Static Dispatch locations only. Centered square alpha exports for existing roadside plots and the island center.
registration: 192 x 192 px square, centered anchor [96, 96]. Front faces toward the bottom. Existing apron and ferry anchors define movement.
derivative: Original PNG preserved byte for byte. Trim alpha below 4, crop transparent padding, fit aspect ratio inside 180 x 180 and center in 192 x 192. Export WebP quality 90 with alpha.
provenance: Project-generated illustrations. No third-party imagery was imported.

assets.label: Depot

assets.prompt: Create one new production game sprite for Transport Dispatch in the approved Miniature World style. A tiny handcrafted gouache and coloured-pencil model village, painted and tactile, soft warm sunlight from upper left, weathered sandstone, clay, slate and subdued teal. Use a steep high three-quarter orthographic camera looking down at about 65 degrees, seeing broad roofs and just enough of the front façade to identify the place. Align the front edge horizontally with the frame, entrance facing screen bottom. One compact, bold, instantly readable silhouette at 20–60 CSS pixels, limited simplified detail, strong local contrast. Entire isolated structure or site centered with at least 8% clear margin on every side, a genuinely transparent background and clean silhouette, no cast shadow outside the subject. At most a close irregular footprint for places that need ground; no rectangular tile backing, framed icon, bubble, platform pedestal, map, road, bridge, vehicle, character, text, lettering, number, watermark or signage with writing. Keep all components physically contiguous. Subject: A transport maintenance and parcel depot in a low pale ochre brick shed, big slate-blue ribbed loading doors, corrugated dark teal sawtooth roof and a few integrated brown cartons at one door. Utilitarian and low, with a single wide loading bay.
